name: Sabiñánigo (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a central band of the four red bars of Aragon on yellow, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the crowned municipal arms of Sabiñánigo within a ring of stars.
history: Municipal flag of Sabiñánigo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: central band bearing the four red bars of Aragon
Sabiñánigo arms — bars of Aragon and a cross, within a ring of stars
shading of the crown of the arms
